## Pre-deployment
- [ ] CI green on exact commit.
- [ ] Backup completed and restore procedure known.
- [ ] Migration reviewed for locks, duration and rollback.
- [ ] Secrets/configuration verified.
- [ ] Queue and scheduler plan confirmed.
- [ ] Stakeholders notified.

## Execution
Record commands/actions in order, with expected results.

## Validation
- [ ] Health check.
- [ ] Login and logout.
- [ ] Vehicle catalogue.
- [ ] Booking and cancellation in safe test data.
- [ ] Mail/queue behavior.
- [ ] Logs and monitoring.

## Rollback
Define trigger, responsible person, application rollback, database recovery and communication.

## Result
Record start/end time, outcome, evidence and follow-up issues.
